import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";

import { Counter, add, tally } from "./scope.js";

describe("scope", () => {
  it("adds", () => {
    expect(add(2, 3)).toBe(5);
  });

  it("tallies", () => {
    expect(tally([1, 2, 3])).toBe(12);
  });

  it("bumps", () => {
    const c = new Counter();
    c.bump();
  });
});
